$description: Trigger evals for stark plugin skills. 20 train + 20 validation. Run each 5x for variance analysis. Use to optimize SKILL.md descriptions without overfitting to specific keywords.
$instructions: Each entry has 'prompt' (user request), 'expected_skill' (which stark skill should trigger), and 'should_trigger' (true if any skill in this plugin should fire; false for negative controls). Evaluate trigger rate on train set, optimize descriptions, then validate on holdout.
